blocks.x: What happened after you left Burnley?

That's when I quit playing music I stopped for, oh, a long time I didn't play...after I quit Burnley's band Cats tried to get me to come back with Joe Klessy The Red Burger was playing with him, you remember Red?
No, no, not Red Burger Red, you're talking...his name is Burger But this is...Burg...Burg...Red Burgman
No, no, he played with...uh... He played with Joe Klessy I don't know who else he played with
He's alive today? No, he's dead
I don't know who I've heard of him I think He played a loud trumpet He had a nice trumpet And cats tried to get me to come back I just got away from music and... Didn't fool with him
